rejected.reason: The nearly all-white panel has extremely low contrast and too little recoverable visual information at preview resolution, risking weak interface legibility.
This repeated oversized ivory-glyph specimen duplicates the selected black-and-ivory typographic territory while offering less numeric variety and a less adaptable crop.
The extreme cropped word fragment is a close duplicate from the same specimen family and is less useful for a legible map interface than the selected numeric specimen.

Its isolated orange and burgundy isometric spot icons are more playful and pictorial than the desired restraint; the selected technical axonometric study provides a more coherent illustration language.
The high-saturation cyberpunk token palette is vivid but conflicts with the restrained warm-neutral, graphite, alpine-mint mapping system.
The dense cyan-on-black terminal treatment reads as retro cyber UI and conflicts with scenic warmth; the selected type specimen covers numeric hierarchy more compatibly.

selected.rationale: The angled black-and-ivory publication spread combines a dimensional terrain model with contour-like linework, supplying the strongest map/topographic cue, editorial restraint, and tactile texture without dictating a literal interface.

The black-and-ivory specimen pairs oversized monospaced or slab-like type, a clear numeral run, repeated glyphs, small annotations, and a strict modular split; it supports legible coordinates, measurements, labels, and disciplined editorial hierarchy.

Four precise axonometric technical drawings alternate across light and dark fields, providing an implementable line language for terrain tiles, map insets, and system diagrams while retaining geometric restraint.

The spacious white principles sheet uses repeated columns, small circular diagrams, short captions, and generous whitespace, making it a practical model for brand-kit modules, legends, route attributes, and explanatory states.

A graphite presentation canvas frames clean content cards and an orderly warm swatch matrix, contributing a useful token-presentation structure and warm-neutral support colors to be adapted rather than copied.

The softly lit scene uses desaturated mint and blue-gray surfaces, dusty rose accents, off-white objects, and diffuse ambient light; borrow its alpine-adjacent softness and color balance, not its office subject.
